design_gotchas.title: SOT-23-3 Pinout (1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN) Reversed vs AP7333-SA, AP7313-SA, and LM3480
design_gotchas.detail: AP2210N-3.3TRG1 uses Pin 1=GND, Pin 2=VOUT, Pin 3=VIN (matching AP7313-33SRG-7 SOT23R). It is strictly pin-incompatible with AP7333-33SAG-7 / AP7313-33SAG-7 (1=IN, 2=OUT, 3=GND) and TI LM3480IM3-3.3/NOPB (1=VOUT, 2=VIN, 3=GND).

design_gotchas.title: Bipolar Pass Transistor Ground Current Jumps to 4 mA Typ (15 mA Max) at 300 mA Load
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike CMOS LDOs with flat micro-amp IQ, AP2210 uses a bipolar pass element (Note 10). Ground pin current climbs from 100 uA at 100 uA load to 350 uA at 50 mA, 1.3 mA at 150 mA, and 4 mA typ (10 mA max at 25°C, 15 mA max over temp) at 300 mA, significantly reducing efficiency at heavy load.

design_gotchas.title: Minimum ESR Stability Floor (~20–30 mOhm) — Not Unconditionally Ceramic-Cap Stable
design_gotchas.detail: Page 22 ESR vs. Output Current plots show a lower ESR instability region below ~25 mOhm (COUT = 2.2 uF) and rising to ~150 mOhm at 0 mA when COUT = 1 uF. Very low-ESR MLCC ceramic capacitors (5–10 mOhm) may oscillate unless a 2.2 uF+ capacitor with verified >=30 mOhm ESR or a small series damping resistor is used.

design_gotchas.title: 13.2 V Operating Rating Requires Severe Current Derating in SOT-23-3 (θJA = 200 C/W)
design_gotchas.detail: While AP2210N survives 15 V abs max / 13.2 V operating VIN (with built-in reverse current protection), regulating 12 V down to 3.3 V drops 8.7 V across the pass transistor. At θJA = 200 °C/W and TA = 50 °C, maximum allowable current before hitting TJ = 150 °C is under 58 mA.

typical_use_cases: 9 V or 12 V industrial/battery rails stepped down to low-current 3.3 V logic (<60 mA) in SOT-23-3
High-PSRR (75 dB at 100 Hz) 3.3 V supplies with reverse-current protection on 1=GND, 2=VOUT, 3=VIN footprints
Higher-VIN upgrade candidate for 6 V-limited SOT23R (1=GND, 2=OUT, 3=IN) boards when ESR and IGND are verified
Portable wireless and consumer electronics requiring ±1% initial accuracy at 25°C
engineering_summary: The Diodes Incorporated AP2210N-3.3TRG1 is a 300 mA, 13.2 V-rated (15 V abs max) fixed 3.3 V (±1% at 25°C) RF LDO in a 3-pin SOT-23-3 package with Pin 1=GND, Pin 2=VOUT, and Pin 3=VIN. It offers 250 mV typical dropout at 300 mA, 75 dB PSRR at 100 Hz, built-in reverse-current protection, and θJA = 200 °C/W. Unlike CMOS LDOs, its bipolar pass stage draws up to 4 mA typ (15 mA max) ground current at 300 mA load and exhibits a ~25 mOhm lower ESR stability boundary (Page 22), requiring careful output capacitor ESR selection and thermal derating at high VIN.
